_why: D74 complete creation: the Desktop app tree has no CHARTER.md of its own, and the placement engine resolves its domain (Desktop) but leaves CHARTER_ID empty because the standing charter is held by the PARENT domain. This row names the charter those files answer to, so a new file under sutra-ui carries all four dimensions without inventing one per creation.
